credit.name: South Carolina Jobs Tax Credit
credit.summary: Annual statutory credit per net new full-time job, varying by county designation tier.

benefit._note: Tier III county per-job amount. Lower-tier (more distressed) counties qualify for higher amounts; this stub uses Charleston/Greenville-style metro pricing.

2025._note: June 4 CALC-03: SC = NO wage test, 32-hour threshold, part-time tier 20-32 hrs counted as 0.5. Replaces the prior (incorrect) 35-hr/$580 stub. Confirm with the partner (PILOT-02).

one_zero._note: SC JTC Base Calculation per CALC-03: no weekly-wage test (min_weekly_wages = 0), 32-hr full-time threshold, and a 20-32 hr part-time band counted as 0.5 of a head. Headcount tested at county granularity.
